title: Review scenarios: services, CI pipelines and secrets

objectives.text: Choose the Compose setup and start command that add a FastAPI service with its own database, reached by service name, listening on an address other containers can reach
Choose the workflow change that keeps a registry credential out of the file and the logs and limits GITHUB_TOKEN to reading repository contents
Predict whether a workflow's image job is skipped, only builds, or builds and pushes, from its trigger, its needs and its push setting
